name: Echoes of Betrayal

source.title: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

stealth.details: (master) to hear the quiet murmurs of angry spirits

disable: DC 35 Religion check (master) three times to exorcise the spirits or DC 39 Diplomacy check (expert) three times to talk them down.
reset: After 24 hours, the haunt returns. The spirits are permanently put to rest only if a lawfully appointed judge from Saggorak (or Kovlar) comes into the prison, takes damage from the haunt, and survives the attack.
routine: (1 action) As 1 action, the haunt causes a barrage of ghostly fists to lash from the walls, floors, and ceiling. The haunt attempts a spectral fist Strike against each creature in area H10.

items.name: Confuse
items.text:
Trigger At least three creatures enter area H10.

---

Effect The haunt takes control of all creatures in the prison, affecting them with Confusion (8th level, DC 37 Will save save).

text: Malevolent spirits led by a ghostly image of Ludika rise and begin a deadly brawl. These spirits attempt to overwhelm living creatures, forcing them to join the battle.
